title: Introduce atomic stream-cancel API and unify retry profiles across SDKs
author: Jasmin Ortega
description: Motivation: customer incidents and internal integrations exposed inconsistencies in how the Python/TS/Go SDKs handle streaming cancellation and retry semantics. This PR introduces a small, explicit 'atomic stream cancel' API surface to avoid partial drain races, and harmonizes retry profile names and defaults across SDKs to make cross-language behavior predictable for production systems. The change set includes: 1) a language-agnostic contract for stream cancellation (CancelToken + finalizer hook) implemented in each SDK, 2) a compact retry-profile DSL (fast, balanced, conservative) with explicit idempotency tiers, 3) small ergonomic shims for async iterables/pull-stream consumers to prefer non-blocking cancel semantics, and 4) coordinated version bumps for the three SDKs. Backwards compatibility: the old cancel/abort helpers are retained as thin wrappers that emit a deprecation warning for one release cycle; retry profile aliases are accepted for backward compatibility by mapping legacy names to the new DSL. Migration notes: consumers who relied on synchronous stream close side-effects should switch to awaiting stream.cancel() in the next release; service-side semantics unchanged. Testing & rollout: feature flagged in runtime to allow staged rollouts; integration test matrix added for py/ts/go interop. Checklist: implement API in each SDK, add interop tests, document new retry profiles in release notes, add deprecation notices, verify CI stability across matrix. Impact: safer cancellation semantics reduce incidents from partial KV-cache flush races and make timeouts/retries consistent across client languages.
commits: feat(protocol): add atomic cancel token and protocol doc (js/py/go)
chore(sdk): map legacy retry profiles to new DSL and add migration tests
feat(py): expose Stream.cancel async method and deprecation shim for close()
feat(ts): introduce PullStream.cancelable() and update types
feat(go): add CancelHandle interface and doc examples
test: add cross-sdk interop matrix and deterministic cancel scenario
docs: add migration guide and retry profile table
